thread:
Maya: Bringing up aurora-lite-18B-int4x canary. Seeing intermittent p99 spikes and a pair of OOMs during long completions. Posting short logs and current defaults.
Owen: paste logs? suspect fragmentation + a big workspace alloc.
Maya: log snippet:
```
E 09:01:03 oom: workspace alloc failed (req=384MB)
W 09:01:03 allocator: fragmented=true free_chunks=9 largest=40MB
I 09:01:04 kv_cache: size=980MB autotrim=false
```
Lina: defaults pushed for canary?
Maya: currently:
```
model: aurora-lite-18B-int4x
max_new_tokens: 768
batch_size: 5
prefetch_kv: true
reserve_mb: 0
microbatch: false
```
Owen: 768 + batch 5 on shared slots is a safe bet to hit fragmentation. Quick mitigations: lower max_new_tokens to 320, batch_size to 3, enable microbatching (2), set reserve_mb 160.
Lina: also flip prefetch_kv -> "lazy" for canary to avoid eager window allocs. Set slab_compact_interval to 4s.
Maya: proposed config:
```
max_new_tokens: 320
batch_size: 3
microbatch: true
microbatch_size: 2
prefetch_kv: lazy
reserve_mb: 160
slab_compact_interval_sec: 4
```
DevBot: canary deploy @3% with revised defaults (initiated by Maya). Monitoring p95/p99/oom/kv_evictions.
bench-bot: short sim (10k requests): p95 -20%, p99 -15%, mem headroom +240MB, OOMs 0. Quality delta (ROUGE-L) -0.25% vs fp16 baseline.
Maya: quality dip acceptable for general traffic; will add route pin for long-form customers to dedicated slots. Action items: update model-catalog (Maya), add fallback route to aurora-17B-compat (Owen), monitor for 1h soak (Lina).
Lina: opening a tiny allocator patch to improve small-chunk coalescing in next runtime patch (low risk).
Maya: after 1h soak: zero OOMs, p99 stable. Moving canary to 20% and creating a short runbook in #eng-ml. Thanks everyone!
